BiblicalUsage: Eldad and Medad stayed in the camp when the seventy went out, and the Spirit rested on them, and they prophesied in the camp. A young man ran to tell Moses, and Moses answered that he wished all the Lord's people were prophets.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Medad is the proof that God's Spirit is not confined to the tabernacle: He fell on two men who stayed in the camp, and Moses rejoiced instead of envying.
